planner_json.title: Keep each cell's captures and reports after the runner is gone, minus anything holding its key
depends_on: GAW-1 (the report copy the shared loop leaves under the evidence dir before it removes its work dirs)

write_prohibited: test/harness/smoke/cell.mjs - GAW-1, E1, E2 and E9 own it
.spec/** - sprint 01's gate text is sprint 01's to correct
Any file not listed in WRITE-ALLOWED

seed/keyless-leg.description: A cell dir produced by a real keyless claude-code leg through runCell, holding real captures under cell/evidence and a real cell.json
records: 10 evidence paths under cell/evidence in cell.json

seed/capture-holding-key.description: A real node child run through createCapture and spawnCaptured that prints its placeholder binding value on stdout, persisted beside a second capture that does not
records: 2 captures under cell/evidence, one holding the literal placeholder sk-test-placeholder-not-a-key

seed/real-workflow-file.description: The real harness-eval.yml, whose keyed step trap line is executed in a sandbox cell dir by a shell that then exits 7
records: 5 keyed model steps and 1 cell upload in jobs.smoke

specification.objective: Every cell leaves a scanned evidence artifact whose cited paths open from the artifact root, and no uploaded file holds the key its step held.
specification.success_state: After `export.mjs` runs, each cited path in `cell.json` resolves under `cell/export`, and a file holding the key is absent and named in `withheld.json`. Each keyed step exports through a trap on exit, including a failing step. Two new uploads ship only `cell/export/` and `cell/export/reports/`.

requirements.description: GIVEN a real keyless claude-code leg's cell dir, with one report outside `cell/evidence` and one `report_paths` entry naming a missing file WHEN `export.mjs` runs with no binding in the env, and each cited path in `cell.json` is joined to `cell/export` THEN 100% of `evidence_paths` and `report_paths` entries resolve with 0 misses, `report_paths` holds `reports/denied-write-probe.json`, the missing entry is gone, and no entry starts with `/` or `cell/`
requirements.verification_service: real export module over a real keyless leg's files on disk
requirements.positive_example: After export, each of the cell's evidence paths joined to cell/export resolves to a file with the same digest as its source, and a report_paths entry naming reports/denied-write-probe.json in a temp invocation dir resolves at cell/export/reports/denied-write-probe.json.
requirements.red: On base test/harness/smoke/export.mjs does not exist, and the cell's paths read cell/evidence/... and /tmp/..., so joining them to an artifact root opens nothing.

scenario.verification_service: real export module over a real keyless leg's files on disk

would_fail_if: paths stay absolute or stay rooted at cell/
a file is omitted from the copy while the cell still cites it
a report outside cell/evidence is omitted from the export
the rename is removed, so a partial tree is left at cell/export

build_proof.range: anything that proves a reader holding only the artifact can open every path the cell record cites
examples: relative paths plus a copy into one export root

steps: write reports/denied-write-probe.json in a temp invocation dir and add that absolute path to the cell's report_paths
add a second report_paths entry naming a file that does not exist
run export.mjs on the cell dir with no binding in the env
join each cited path in cell.json to cell/export

must_observe: 100% of `evidence_paths` and `report_paths` entries resolve to a file, with 0 misses
`report_paths` holds `reports/denied-write-probe.json`, and the missing file's entry is gone
no entry starts with `/` or `cell/`
`cell/cell.json` still parses with 4 checks

requirements.description: GIVEN real captures with one holding the literal placeholder, and a report holding it outside `cell/evidence` WHEN `export.mjs` runs with the binding env set to the placeholder, the tree is searched for the placeholder and its base64 form, and it runs again with an unreadable file in `cell/evidence` THEN 0 files under `cell/export` hold it, `withheld.json` lists 2 paths, the affected check reads `could-not-run` `evidence-withheld`, and the unreadable run leaves no `cell/export`
requirements.verification_service: real export module over real captures from a real child process
requirements.positive_example: With the placeholder bound, the capture and the report holding it are absent from cell/export, withheld.json names both paths, the check reads could-not-run evidence-withheld, and a grep of cell/export for the placeholder and its base64 form finds 0 files.
requirements.red: On base nothing scans or withholds, so a tree copied for upload holds the placeholder and the grep assertion finds it.

scenario.verification_service: real export module over real captures from a real child process

would_fail_if: the scan is removed and every capture is copied
the scan runs only on stdout, so the same value in stderr or cell.json is omitted
a report read from outside cell/evidence skips the scan and is copied unchecked
a scan crash leaves a tree at cell/export

examples: withheld.json with a path and no value

build_proof.range: anything that proves the upload tree cannot hold the value of the key its own step held
examples: a byte comparison before each copy, with an atomic rename at the end

steps: write a report holding the placeholder in a temp invocation dir and name it in the cell's report_paths
run export.mjs with the binding env set to the placeholder
grep the cell/export tree for the placeholder and its base64 form
run it again with an unreadable file in cell/evidence

must_observe: 0 files under cell/export hold `sk-test-placeholder-not-a-key`
`withheld.json` lists 2 paths and the clean capture is copied
the affected check reads `could-not-run` with reason `evidence-withheld`
the unreadable run leaves no `cell/export` directory
must_not_observe: the placeholder in stdout or in withheld.json
an empty withheld.json on the first run

requirements.description: GIVEN the real `harness-eval.yml` WHEN its `jobs.smoke` is parsed, and a keyed body's trap line runs in bash in a sandbox cell dir before the shell exits 7 THEN 5 keyed steps hold the trap line, uploads `harness-eval-evidence-` and `harness-eval-verify-` carry `github.run_attempt` and ship paths under `cell/export/`, `harness-eval-cell-` still ships `cell/cell.json`, and the shell exits 7 with `cell/export` present
requirements.verification_service: the real workflow file and a real bash run of its trap line
requirements.positive_example: Two new uploads ship cell/export/ and cell/export/reports/ with attempt-qualified names and if: always(); the cell upload still ships cell/cell.json; a shell running the trap line and exiting 7 still leaves cell/export.
requirements.red: On base jobs.smoke has one upload, no keyed step sets a trap, and the grade job's pattern is harness-eval-verify-*.
